compiler_conflicts: Two distinct flits may not occupy the same directed ring edge or local output at the same capture edge.

A valid wire event must equal expected_v, even if no local output selects it.
Every selected input must be valid at capture. Duplicate selection is explicit multicast, not arbitration.
